implementation_readability.default_path_contract: wyag init without path argument defaults explicitly to '.'
implementation_readability.explicit_path_contract: wyag init <path> creates new git repository at target path
implementation_readability.structural_invariants: .git containing HEAD, config, description, objects, refs/heads, refs/tags
implementation_readability.error_handling: wyag init on an existing non-directory file raises clear exception

normalization: Baseline commit dates and author/committer identity are fixed.
Timestamps and author metadata are normalized across Git and wyag.
